release_ready_reason: Active architectural exceptions and red/noisy proof gates remain.

false_success_release_blocker.rule: Fatal-shaped output must not return process exit 0.

exceptions.reason: The enforced denylist classifies more layers and permits edges that the normative five-layer architecture does not allow.
exceptions.removal_condition: One ratified manifest defines allowed layers and edges, and the checker fails every unexpected edge unless an exact governed exception exists.

exceptions.reason: Interface modules construct adapters, decision nodes, orchestration services, and mutable runtime owners.
exceptions.removal_condition: Application-owned composition roots inject facades into transport-only routers, with no runtime owners constructed in interface modules.

exceptions.reason: Core modules perform file and event effects, read clocks, and import implementation services.
exceptions.removal_condition: The core import/effect inventory is allowlist-clean and deterministic core calls consume all nondeterminism as explicit inputs.

exceptions.reason: Request and CLI event-loop paths can reach synchronous file and subprocess operations.
exceptions.removal_condition: Reachability-aware static inventory and live responsiveness/cancellation tests pass with only explicit standalone-script exemptions.

exceptions.reason: The installed orket root now owns the runtime command tree, while python main.py remains a source-wrapper compatibility surface through 0.6.x.
exceptions.removal_condition: Installed-root proof remains green and an explicit 0.7.0 contract delta removes python main.py plus the hidden source-wrapper --rock alias.

exceptions.reason: Decision-node strategy selection still reads environment, path, and provider policy outside explicit input snapshots.
exceptions.removal_condition: All decision nodes receive immutable resolved configuration and have no environment or runtime-state reach-through.

exceptions.reason: Some application and core transitions still read wall-clock time directly.
exceptions.removal_condition: Every deterministic transition receives clock values through explicit runtime inputs.

exceptions.reason: replay_turn() remains as a compatibility wrapper around replay_turn_diagnostics().
exceptions.removal_condition: All supported callers use replay_turn_diagnostics() and the compatibility window is explicitly closed.

exceptions.reason: runtime_verification.json remains as a latest-path compatibility artifact beside canonical indexed history.
exceptions.removal_condition: All supported consumers use the canonical verification index and per-record artifacts.

exceptions.reason: The current event taxonomy remains authoritative while the target identity model is not fully versioned.
exceptions.removal_condition: The target identity schema is versioned, migrated, and named as current event authority.

exceptions.reason: Durable-path defaults and ReviewRun v0 remain current-state specifics inside the target architecture document.
exceptions.removal_condition: Those specifics move to accepted durable contracts or are retired with migration proof.

exceptions.reason: The checker vocabulary omits end_to_end, relies on nearby prose, and leaves most tests unlabeled.
exceptions.removal_condition: Pytest markers are canonical, strict taxonomy reports zero missing tests, and public-surface requirements are enforced.

exceptions.reason: The critical-path no-op checker reports type-only ellipsis signatures as runtime no-ops.
exceptions.removal_condition: The checker excludes type-only declarations and has regression tests with zero known false positives.

exceptions.reason: The repository lint gate is red, so selected green checks do not constitute a release-ready quality envelope.
exceptions.removal_condition: Ruff passes over the canonical governed scope without suppressing categories to clear the count.

exceptions.reason: CURRENT_AUTHORITY.md mixes live authority with an append-only implementation history.
exceptions.removal_condition: A small validated manifest is canonical and generates a bounded human snapshot and historical closeout records.
